cases.detail: Icarus rejects a primitive output connected to a bit member of a packed structure variable as a non-default-strength driver. IEEE 1800-2023 6.5 includes primitive outputs to independent structure elements and automatic assignment conversion; Verilator 5.052 accepts the standalone source in lint mode. The case retains its two-state conversion assertions.
